## History

John Andrew painter was hired to paint the village hall. However, due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers, he painted the hall a glaring blue instead of the intended green, which was discovered by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) after he finished.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

## Relationships

### [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-andrew--roger-pye.md)

John Andrew is the child of [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md). Their familial connection places John within the broader Pye family, who become the target of community blame when the Village Improvement Society's hall is accidentally painted a glaring blue instead of green.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), +2 more_
